verdict.rationale: Smooth is API-first: its REST API covers running tasks, interactive sessions, listing and cancelling tasks, sending session events (goto, extract, evaluate_js, close), custom tools, structured output, proxies and profiles, so the core product is clearly programmable. However, no documentation states UI/API parity, the dashboard-side surface is never enumerated, and no OpenAPI spec was found to confirm coverage. missing for 10: explicit UI-to-API parity statement or mapping, evidence that account/profile/API-key/data-deletion management is available via API, published OpenAPI spec, independent corroboration.
